**Daya dukung (persamaan umum, Meyerhof:
**Bearing capacity (general equation, Meyerhof / Vesic / Hansen)**
- q_ult = c·Nc·sc·dc·ic + q0·Nq·sq·dq·iq + ½·γ·B'·Nγ·sγ·dγ·iγ, with Nq = e^(π tan φ)·tan²(45°+φ/2), Nc = (Nq−1)/tan φ, Nγ = 2(Nq+1)·tan φ (Vesic); φ = 0 → Nc = 5.14
- B', L' = effective dimensions (B − 2ex, L − 2ey); shape factors sc = 1 + (B'/L')(Nq/Nc), sq = 1 + (B'/L') tan φ, sγ = 1 − 0.4 B'/L'; Hansen/Vesic depth factors; Vesic inclination factors (largest exponent m, conservative)
- Base pressure: inside the kern (6ex/B + 6ey/L ≤ 1) linear q = V/(BL)·(1 ± 6ex/B ± 6ey/L); outside the kern one-way triangular q max = 2V / (3·L·(B/2 − e)); two-way uses the Meyerhof effective area q = V/A'

**Equipment foundation**
- Base moment = |M| + |H|·h (absolute values, worst direction). Overturning: FS = V·(B/2)/Mb (and y direction). Sliding: FS = (V·tan δ + ca·A contact + Pp) / H
- Foundation weight is computed automatically: footing, pedestal, and backfill (can be switched off)

**Rotating machinery (indicative)**
- Equivalent circular rigid-plate springs (r0 = √(BL/π)): Kz = 4·G·r0/(1−ν), Kx = 32(1−ν)·G·r0/(7−8ν); fn = ½π·√(K/m); G = (γ/g)·Vs²
- Separation |fn − f_op| / f_op ≥ 20 % (common example) at each harmonic; foundation/machine mass ratio (common example ≥ 3 reciprocating, ≥ 2 centrifugal)

**Tank (API 650, simplified)**
- Liquid pressure p = γw·SG·H; line load to the ringwall = (W shell + W roof + roof live load) / πD; ringwall pressure = (line load + ringwall weight) / b
- Settlement: flexible circular plate on an elastic half-space; centre 2qa(1−ν²)/E, edge 4qa(1−ν²)/(πE)
- Wind: shell pressure 0.86 kPa × (V/190 km/h)² on the projected area; Mw = F·Hs/2; the empty tank is stable if 0.6 Mw ≤ MDL/1.5 + MDLR (API 650 §5.11 criterion (a)); wind shear ≤ 0.4 × empty tank weight

**Limits**
- Simple static/elastic. NOT covered: tank seismic (API 650 Annex E), consolidation or layered settlement, liquefaction, reinforcement design, rocking and coupling of machine foundations (ACI 351.3R), groundwater effects other than through the effective unit weight.
- Default values (FS, temporary-load multiplier, 20 % frequency separation, mass ratio, friction coefficient) are common examples, not project criteria. Follow the Design Basis and the code edition used by the document.
